## Summaries (base R datasets)

```{r}
x <- rivers                                  # lengths of 141 US rivers
c(mean = mean(x), median = median(x), sd = sd(x), IQR = IQR(x))
fivenum(x)                                   # Tukey hinges (as in the problem set)
summary(x)                                   # quantile type 7: slightly different
q <- fivenum(x); iqr <- q[4] - q[2]
c(lower = q[2] - 1.5 * iqr, upper = q[4] + 1.5 * iqr, flagged = sum(x > q[4] + 1.5 * iqr))
```

## Plots

```{r}
hist(x, freq = FALSE, breaks = 25, main = "", xlab = "miles")
boxplot(x, horizontal = TRUE)
plot(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg, xlab = "weight", ylab = "mpg"); cor(mtcars$wt, mtcars$mpg)
```

## n versus n - 1

```{r}
y <- c(1, 3, 4, 6, 6)
c(var(y), sum((y - mean(y))^2) / length(y))   # R uses n - 1: 4.5 versus 3.6
```

## z-scores and the ECDF

```{r}
z <- scale(y); c(mean(z), sd(z))
Fn <- ecdf(c(2, 3, 3, 5, 8)); Fn(c(1, 3, 4, 8))
plot(ecdf(rivers), main = "ECDF of rivers")
```

## Categorical data

```{r}
tab <- table(mtcars$cyl); tab; round(prop.table(tab), 3)
barplot(tab, xlab = "cylinders", ylab = "count")
```
